text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I know dwelling on it won't help… I should just shake it off and move onto the next race… But I can't stop thinking about how I could have done better…
choice_data_list: You should be proud for seeing the race through to the end.
Use that frustration as the springboard to future success!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Y-you're right. I suppose I don't regret everything about today's race.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: My physical skills might not have made the cut, but at least my fighting spirit did.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I won't give up no matter what! I'll definitely win next time!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm going to work even harder! Instead of lamenting today, I'm going to learn from this experience!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …Yeah. Wallowing in sadness isn't going to make my dream come true.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: My dad was a sumo wrestler, and no matter how many times he lost, he never missed a single practice.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Being able to hold your head up, look forward, and keep your heart strong is an amazing thing!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I won't give up either, and next time, I'm going to win using sheer willpower!
